_about: One asset per ROOM_FIXTURES rev7 register counter row (RI 1.5 rows 98/101, REF-011; RI 8.1; DEC-039). Local frame: staff side -Y (asset front, shows the cabinet construction), customer face +Y, run along X; ART yaws the asset so +Y points to the RF 'faces' direction, and plan_axis_x = the plan direction local +X then points along (faces S: -x west; W: -y north; N: +x east). Station local_x_m = RF POS_xx pos_ft minus the RF counter centre, measured along plan_axis_x. Every value below is cited in _sources.

_sources.length_m / depth_m / height_m: RF size_ft of the variant's `rf` row (depth 2.2 ft North/East/South, 2.0 ft SouthReturn); height 2.833 ft = TI 6.4 34 in max AFF (0.8636). RF depth 2.2 ft vs TI 2'-6" POS top: RF used, conflict GAP-PROC-23
_sources.top_t_m: TI 6.4 POS cabinet quartz top with a 2 in edge
_sources.toe_h_m / toe_recess_m: TI 6.4 4 in toe base, 2 in recess
_sources.carcass_depth_m: TI 6.4 2'-1" overall base-cabinet depth; SouthReturn 22.5 in so it fits the RF 2.0 ft row (GAP-PROC-22)
_sources.gable_t_m: GAP-PROC-22 (3/4 in carcass board, construction convention)
_sources.face_panel_t_m / face_sheet_w_m: DEC-090 plywood front; 3/4 in thickness and 4 ft sheet width are GAP-PROC-22
_sources.seam_m: construction detail (hairline seam between wrap sheets)
_sources.accent_band_h_m / reveal_m / pull_w_frac: TI 6.4 ML-1 band, drawer reveals, HW-2 edge pulls exist; sizes GAP-PROC-15
_sources.staff_overhang_m: GAP-PROC-22 (top overhang past the staff-side drawer fronts)
_sources.drawer_cabinet_w_m: TI 6.4 detail 11 two-drawer POS cabinet (two equal drawers) under each monitor; width GAP-PROC-22
_sources.max_open_bay_m / open_shelf_z_frac: open black under-shelves R2C3 + RI 2.2 'open black shelves under the counter'; bay width and shelf height GAP-PROC-22
_sources.grommet_d_m / grommet_inset_m / grommet_: GAP-PROC-15 (one cable grommet per station; the flange top is the 34 in bound, the slab top sits grommet_lip_m below it)
_sources.monitor_inset_m: RF POS_xx pos_ft: monitor centre 0.22 ft inside the staff edge (y 7.22 vs edge 7.0); RI 8.1 'monitor centre on the staff edge'. Used for station_anchors position
_sources.anchor_offsets: SCENE_ANCHORS Anchor_Register_NN_Operator 1.0 ft off the staff edge, _Call 1.2 ft off the customer face (RI 8.1)
_sources.components: slot set RI 2.2 (monitor, keyboard, receipt printer, scanner, customer-facing card terminal) + DEC-086 card terminal; scale_stand_slot dx -1.8 ft / dy +0.65 ft from RF POS_xx stand_rect (1.6 x 1.3 ft, staff's right of the monitor, RI 2.2); every other dx/dy is GAP-PROC-15 (RF monitor at the staff edge leaves no room for the keyboard; see notes question)
_sources.display_case_slot_x_m: RI 1.5 row 99 display case x 38.0-39.4 (centre 38.7) minus the North centre x 30.3 = 8.4 ft east = local -8.4 ft; 1.4 x 1.4 ft footprint
_sources.colors.Quartz_QZ2: TI 6.4 QZ-2 white quartz top (CCTV RI 2.2 reads black stone-look: GAP-PROC-23)
_sources.colors.Wrap_DeliChecker: DEC-090 decorative wrap on plywood; RF Counter_Register_North notes + RI 8.1 (both runs) 'DELI STYLE' teal/white checker; flat teal = average tone until the print texture exists (GAP-PROC-22)
_sources.colors.Black_ML1: TI 6.4 ML-1 black-patina metal laminate (band, toe kicks, banding); R2C5 'black cabinet end' (SouthReturn)
_sources.colors.Black_ML1_Interior: TI 6.4 black melamine interiors; R2C3 black open shelves
_sources.colors.Walnut_WD1: TI 6.4 WD-1 walnut veneer / PL-1 walnut laminate fronts; value = a typical dark walnut tone (linear), shade not measured (GAP-PROC-22)
_sources.colors.Plastic_Grommet: GAP-PROC-22 neutral mid grey (grommet colour unsourced)
_sources.colors.Steel_Pins: construction hardware (shelf pins, screws), neutral mid grey
_sources.finishes: proctex RULES except Black_ML1_Interior -> laminate (melamine), Steel_Pins -> brushed_metal, Wrap_DeliChecker -> plastic (vinyl wrap)
_sources.wear: PROC-005 wear defaults (shader params, not store facts)
